<u>These Heroes may use Cards of this Class:</u>
KABLOOM CLASS\n\nFast. Builds a rapid, yet flimsy field to overwhelm the zombie hero as they mow down the early game zombies with direct damage.
MEGA-GROW CLASS\n\nA modest pace. Not exactly fast, not slow either. Great at simply keeping tempo with the opponent, always a bit ahead in every aspect. Stats, damage, and even cards.
GUARDIAN CLASS\n\nGenerally defensive cards with subpar offense, great at slowing the pace of the game.

SMARTY CLASS\n\nRestrictive. Prefers to keep things locked down as much as possible, covering as many angles as they can. Tends to have more cards drawn so they always have another card to fall back on.

SOLAR CLASS\n\nNothing but me. Excels at keeping fields clear of enemies, no matter how bulky they are, and keeping their own side big and healthy. Not exactly the class you want to be fighting head-on.

BRAINY CLASS\n\nImpatience. They want an advantage, one way or another. They'll act first before the plants can react, and play more costly cards before you can even blink, and when the plant hero finally gets a turn, they come back with even more tricks up their sleeves.

HEARTY CLASS\n\nNo. That's what they tell you. Whatever you plan on doing, no. They have high health, healing, and can slow the game down pretty well, but eventually your lesser field will be blown away by their own, or use it against you.

SNEAKY CLASS\n\nWait. It's not your turn. They dart around the field and make every play more difficult. They mess with your plants a lot, freezing, using deadly, bouncing, striking through multiple, all while building something up in their pocket. And you won't see it coming.

BEASTLY CLASS\n\nLawnmower. Stays omnipresent with higher stats, constant healing, and multiple ways of hunting down and blitzing through the opponent's field. If something goes awry, they'll usually have some random cheaper cards to fall back on.

CRAZY CLASS\n\nExplosive. Damage. That's the name of the game, and they have a lot of it. Things can get out of hand extremely quickly given their high damage, plant trampling, and direct pot-shots at the plant hero.

Week 10 Day 1:\nTake down Electric Boogaloo and his 'Astromany 101' Strategy Deck with Nightcap's equally cosmic 'Faceblaster 9001' Strategy Deck. You also start with Grape of the Planets in the middle Lane to help you out!
Week 10 Day 2:\nWho knew Sasquatch was invited! Take on him and his 'High Seas High Jinks' Strategy Deck with Citron's 'Water Works' Strategy Deck in this water filled battlefield!
Week 10 Day 3:\nThis party seems to be equipped with a 'Feast for Beasts'. Maybe Chompzilla's 'Cukes of Hazard' Srategy Deck will help you take them out?

Week 10 Day 4:\nElectric Boogaloo is back, and this time he's living up to his name! His moves are so shocking that both Heroes take <color=red>3</color> damage at the start of each tun. Hopefully Wall-Knight's 'Pop Star' Strategy Deck will help you take back that lost health.
Week 10 Day 5:\nTake on Professor Brainstorm with Grass Knuckles' 'Bullseye Beatdown' Strategy Deck before his 'Dancing Among the Stars' Strategy Deck sends you to them as well.
Week 10 Day 6:\nMelt down Rustbolt's nuts, bolts and his 'Combo Stomper' Strategy Deck with Solar Flare's 'Bloom and Doom' Strategy Deck.
Party Time!\nStart of Turn: 2 random Party or Dancing Zombies do [green=1] Bonus Attack.

Week 10 Day 7:\nWrite the deadliest disstrack on Electric Boogaloo and his 'No Escape' Strategy Deck with Spudow's 'Berry Powerful' Strategy Deck. The 'Wilted Rose' Trinket and 'Slot Machine' Trick will both aid you in battle (but you only get 1 of each so be careful!)

Week 11 Day 1:\nParties are best served at nighttime! Which is exactly where we are right now. Protect these Twin Sunflowers with Red Shadow's 'Mean Beans' Strategy Deck alongside an extra piece of Intensive Carrot.
<u>Nighttime</u>\nYou don't gain any Sun at the start of Turns.

Week 11 Day 2:\nHuge-Chriztmatacus has a Kajemorphic set up in the middle Lane, but that's all he's got, because he's using his 'Outsmarted' Strategy Deck. Can you beat him with Rose's 'Cool Deck, Bro'?

Week 11 Day 3:\nNot only do you need to protect these Twin Sunflowers, you also immediately lose if they get destroyed! Try and prevent Impfinity and his 'Pain in the Poop Deck' Strategy Deck from doing so with Mycelium Maestro's 'Berry Dangerous' Strategy Deck.
<u>Save Our Seeds!</u>\nProtect the endangered Plants - getting them destroyed results in a loss.

Week 11 Day 4:\nElectric Boogaloo and his goons don't seem to appreciate your presence. Prove them that you're the superstar of this party with Captain Combustible's 'Poison Powerhouse' Strategy Deck in a nasty iteration of Last Stand!

<u>Last Stand</u>\nPrepare a defense with your entire Deck drawn out in your Hand and 50 starting Sun. Each Turn a wave of random Zombies from either of your opponent's Hero Classes appears on the board. The opponent doesn't Draw any Cards, so your only goal is to survive!

Week 11 Day 5:\nIt appears your Twin Sunflowers haven't even sprouted yet.
